headline: Agents Audit Systems in Six Disciplined Phases
lede: Cloudflare’s security-audit-skill turns coding agents into a coordinated review team. Reconnaissance, vulnerability hunting, independent verification, and machine-readable ledgers create a repeatable path from suspicion to evidence.

headline: PHP Keeps Its Runtime Engine Tuned
lede: PHP’s source repository contains the interpreter, Zend Engine, standard library, extensions, and the tests that hold them together. Build it from source to inspect the runtime, optimize performance, or shape the language for a custom deployment.

headline: Claude Learns the Shape of Enterprise Work
lede: Anthropic’s knowledge-work-plugins package role-specific skills, commands, and connectors for tools such as Jira, Slack, Notion, and data warehouses. Its file-based architecture gives organizations a practical control layer for turning a general assistant into a domain-aware operator.

headline: OpenShell Puts Agents Behind Policy Walls
lede: NVIDIA OpenShell gives autonomous agents a private, isolated runtime with controls over files, processes, networks, credentials, and APIs. Supervisors, gateways, and policy analysis keep high-impact changes reviewable before agents reach sensitive infrastructure.

headline: A Classical Astrology Engine Maps the Heavens
lede: ziwei-doushu encodes Zi Wei Dou Shu chart generation, calendar conversion, true-solar-time correction, star transformations, and interpretive source material. Its deterministic TypeScript engine and structured datasets make a culturally specific practice inspectable, testable, and reusable.

headline: Claude Gets a Structured Offensive Playbook
lede: Claude-Red organizes offensive-security knowledge into focused skills covering reconnaissance, web flaws, cloud, wireless, identity, exploitation, and post-exploitation. Loaded on demand, the modular files support authorized assessments and training while keeping attack methodology close to the operator’s chosen surface.

headline: VoxCPM Gives Open Speech a Human Texture
lede: VoxCPM2 is a 2-billion-parameter, tokenizer-free text-to-speech model trained across 30 languages and more than two million hours of speech. Its diffusion-autoregressive design supports voice cloning, natural-language prosody control, and 48 kHz output across local and production serving stacks.

headline: Node.js Powers the JavaScript Everywhere Era
lede: Node.js remains the durable runtime beneath servers, command-line tools, automation, and high-concurrency services. V8, non-blocking I/O, npm, and a disciplined release model keep its broad ecosystem moving across current and long-term-support channels.
